title: Weekly digest: items file for one issue
description: One issue of a weekly digest: issue details plus the items found that week. build_digest.py checks every items file against this schema. See items.example.yaml for a commented example.

brand.description: Your business or newsletter name, shown at the top.

title.description: Name of the digest, e.g. 'Battery Storage Zoning Watch'.

coverage.description: What was checked, e.g. 'Sources checked October 7, 2026'.

intro.description: Two or three sentences at the top of the issue.

timezone.description: Time zone for times in deadlines, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Default America/New_York.

timezone_label.description: Short label shown after times, e.g. 'ET'.

mailing_address.description: Your postal address. US law (CAN-SPAM) requires one in commercial email.

manage_url.description: Link to manage or cancel a subscription (or a mailto: link).

sources_checked.description: Number of official sources checked for this issue.

sources_note.description: One line on what kinds of sources you check.

attribution.description: Credit lines some open-data licences require.

sample_notice.description: Shown as a banner. Use it for samples and trial issues.

disclaimer.description: Replaces the standard 'not legal advice' text.

file_name.description: Base name for the output files.

sections.description: Order of the categories in the issue. Categories not listed come after, A to Z.

skipped_changes.description: Changes that were looked at and left out, with the reason. Not shown to subscribers.

date_or_datetime.description: YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day date, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a time (in the issue's time zone).

status.description: draft or needs_review: not checked yet. approved: a person checked it against the source. rejected: left out.

short_title.description: Optional shorter title for the 'Coming up' list and the calendar, e.g. 'Tarrow County vote on battery storage pause'.

summary.description: What the document says, in your own words.

why_it_matters.description: Facts that explain the effect. No advice.

jurisdiction.description: Government body or area, e.g. 'Tarrow County'.

source_name.description: Official source, e.g. 'Tarrow County Commissioners, agenda for October 13, 2026'.

source_url.description: Link to the official document itself.

source_ref.description: Where in the document: page, item or section.

date.description: Date of the document or action (posted, filed or published).

deadline.description: Next date that matters: hearing, vote, comment or bid deadline.

deadline_label.description: What happens on that date, e.g. 'Public hearing'.

details.description: Extra facts shown as a small table, e.g. {'Bid number': 'B-26-114', 'Last winning bid': '$71,400 (2025)'}.

priority.description: high shows the item as a top item.

checked_by.description: Initials of the person who checked it against the source.

review_notes.description: Notes for the reviewer. Never shown to subscribers.
